--CETAS
-- CREATE EXTERNAL TABLE AS 


CREATE EXTERNAL TABLE revenue_cetas
WITH
(
    LOCATION = 'cetas_revenue',
    DATA_SOURCE = raw_ext_source,
    FILE_FORMAT = PARQUET_FORMAT
)
AS
SELECT * FROM
OPENROWSET
(
    BULK 'revenue/revenue_star.csv',
    DATA_SOURCE = 'raw_ext_source',
    FORMAT = 'CSV',
    PARSER_VERSION = '2.0',
    HEADER_ROW = TRUE
) AS QUERY1;
